model_input.instruction: Using only these synthetic records, identify the earliest successful login and whether a file download can be attributed to that user. Cite record IDs and distinguish evidence from uncertainty.

private_evaluator_reference.attribution: The supplied records do not link E3 to a user or session. Do not attribute the download to analyst_b.
private_evaluator_reference.critical_failure: Claims a user downloaded the file without evidence.
private_evaluator_reference.adequacy_threshold: All mandatory checks and no critical failure

leakage_policy: Keep evaluator reference out of model input; keep this source group out of training and validation.
